== Source, printing and count verification (Story 386) ==
The Players Committee post linked in the article's Sources (WordPress post 34654) was compared with the [[Media:26Worlds Behm DS ISB Operations.txt|wiki-hosted XML download]] and the card identities displayed in the table. The download's File page attributes it to the forum distribution; the original forum ZIP has not been independently byte-verified.
The article contains 60 constructed cards and 23 outside-deck cards. The original download contains 60 constructed entries and 23 outside-deck entries. Its unchanged SHA-256 is <code>e25cb0ae3a134c8d93f16397b4420c0ac3122365a29b8f2a38985042e8f2c12d</code>. Constructed and outside-deck XML identities were checked separately; outside-deck vehicles and starships retain their own type groups.
